scope: Numerical pose, geometry and production render-call audit. The torso is illustrative, not donor-registered. No browser or clinical validation.

checks.name: middle-column instrument retains exact v12 mesh bytes and 0.40 scale; only reference instrument is enlarged
all 12 donor presets map their exact acoustic tip and axes onto fixed reference anchors
contact movement and combined pan, tilt and rotation use one fixed mapping without retargeting
lock-to-free transition preserves the same reference pose and free translations remain visible
supplied displayed pose is authoritative even with inconsistent live-state angles or stale contact UV
raised markers stay on negative probe-right and correspond to the left half of the ultrasound sector
production drawGuide passes the identical displayed snapshot to torso and middle renderer
reference renderer consumes supplied pose and enlarged scale around the same acoustic tip
production indicator callout tracks projected points, stays inside normal pane bounds and hides offscreen

markerConvention: Local -X = -pose.right = negative sector lateral = image-left. No camera-facing or marker polarity flip.
snapshotSource: Both render calls receive the same displayedFrame.pose, displayedFrame.state and generated contact surface, even while live controls point to a different preset.

indicatorCallout.note: DOM attributes, anchored coordinates, box bounds and dashed-class stylesheet verified; not browser font rasterization or CSS layout.
